items.text: Steam Deck and Steam Machine Verified.
Improved main character physics and collision.
All text migrated to TextMesh Pro.
Fixed missing text in the Linux version for several languages.
Updated main menu with improved controller navigation.
On the first launch, the game language matches the Steam client language.
Linux: Runtime environment switched to Steam Linux Runtime 4.0.
The game actually turned 10 back in May, but who cares? The game continues to get better. Thank you to everyone who has been along for the ride all these years!
Fixed issue CVE-2025-59489: Let me know if you have any problems after the update.
-Improvements under the hood of the game
The engine has been updated to Unity 2020
Mac: Added support for Apple Silicon
Small Fixes: Let me know if you find any problems.
The game has received an updated trailer. Trailer music added to soundtrack.
-Now the jump height depends on the duration of pressing jump button.
-Improved the mechanics of interacting with enemies.
-Improved music manager. At level 50, there is now a new track.
-Increased speed and other parameters of the character.
-Many levels have been slightly modified for new controls.
-Game settings are now available in the pause menu.
-Added translation into Malay and Romanian languages.
And many more minor changes. Let me know if you have any problems after the update.

notes.title: Soon will be released a big update! The main changes

items.text: -Improved control, now the height of the jump will depend on the duration of pressing.
There are also many other small improvements. The game will become even better and more fair to the player.
-Added Serbian Localization (Thanks Marko Josifović and Radoš Milićev)!
-Added controller vibration. You can disable in the settings.
-Fixed Down Button transition to the next level.
-Above the door is displayed gamepad or keyboard button.
-Double jump works correctly after killing enemy.
-Now you do not need to release the walk key after death.
-Linux build now x86_64 (That's better? I do not know).
Supported Steam Controller, Xbox One/360, Dualshock 4 and others gamepads.
Please, let me know if you have found any problems.

Small Fixes and optimizations.: Unfortunately the old save data was easy to lose for example after reinstalling the system. If you have old save - just run the game and the save data will be automatically updated and sent to the Steam Сloud.
I forgot what else :/: Please, let me know if you have found any problems.
Fixed Korean localization.: Please, let me know if you have found any problems.
Added Korean localization. Thanks Dollppin!: Please, let me know if you have found any problems.
